pre_run_hypotheses: All 25 populated authored tables import and export exactly, convert with zero errors and only warning #108 plus two item-specific notice #2034 messages, and yield valid nonempty SXI, SXO, event log and 84 half-hour System/Stock report rows.

At least two installed LRU failures produce aircraft-level LRU demands. Removed LRUs expose failed SRUs and receive local SRU replacements in their item-specific 0.75-hour SURP, then return to LRU stock; at least one repaired physical LRU serves a later system demand.

Each removed failed SRU travels from BASE-01 to DEPOT-01, receives the referenced level-2 F01-SRU-DIRP one-hour repair, and returns to BASE-01 stock after the two-hour return route; at least one repaired physical SRU serves a later LRU repair.

No LRU or aircraft repair is silently moved to DEPOT-01, and no SRU direct repair starts at BASE-01. Track individual material IDs, site positions, stock transactions, transport, backorders, task resources and terminal in-transit items.

Reconcile every mission result, failure, repair, 84 report intervals and terminal readiness/stock with raw events. Require no outstanding observed SRU transport, depot repair or backorder at the 42-hour terminal interval. Compare the local parent descriptively, without assuming unchanged random times or aggregate equality.
decision_rule: Accept this bounded two-location/two-level combination only if all source, native, roundtrip, event, physical stock, report and terminal assertions pass and a separate read-only reviewer independently replays the raw evidence. If the native model does not express the frozen routing or misses the repeated reissue gate, retain it as a sealed diagnostic and design a fresh version; do not change this contract after observing the run.
limits: One aircraft, one LRU/SRU chain, one base and one depot, one seed and a 42-hour horizon; no ASSY, PM, explicit failure-mode CM, resource scarcity, other levels or station networks.
The model tests one task category/level allocation to depot, not general two-level maintenance selection or issue #403's nested replacement boundary.
GUI-only behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
